name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *only* new-contributor PRs for two weeks. This tests the tool’s edge-case catching without risking friction on core contributors—trade-off is missing bugs in veteran PRs. If it performs well, we expand to all PRs; if not, we scrap it without disrupting the team.

name: Gauge
text: The real risk isn’t missing bugs in veteran PRs—it’s normalizing noise so reviewers ignore *all* PR-Agent output, even when it flags something critical. A better alternative is running it in shadow mode on *random* PRs (10-20%) to avoid bias toward new contributors while still stress-testing edge cases. Settle it by tracking reviewer response rates to PR-Agent comments over two weeks—if engagement drops, the experiment fails.
